'''Gyldan''' was the name of a [[Red Ajah|Red]] sister who was also [[Black Ajah]].{{ref/book|3|22}}

==Activities==
Gyldan appears in [[Egwene al'Vere]]'s third step during her testing for [[Accepted]] in the [[Silver arches]] ''[[ter'angreal]]''. Gyldan is [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan|Elaida]]'s close confidant and is one of thirteen sisters of the Black Ajah who were going to turn Egwene to the [[Shadow]] with thirteen [[Myrddraal]]. It is unknown if there is a real [[Aes Sedai]] with this name.{{ref/book|3|22}}
